title: H1.37-R same-period BASE bridge for frozen-adapter evaluation
objective: Re-run only the original-period H1.37 BASE cells (the first 48 manifest tasks x the original four seeds) unchanged, to quantify period/runtime stability and recompute SELF-resumed versus contemporaneous BASE-R.
scientific_question: Were the H1.37 BASE results materially affected by the original-versus-resumed execution period, and does SELF-EVOLUTION retain any transfer signal when compared with an unchanged BASE re-run in the resumed period?
rationale: H1.37 was underpowered and its 48 original-period BASE cells had a higher mean score than its 16 resumed-period BASE cells, while all SELF-EVOLUTION cells were resumed-period. This bridge changes no scientific object and consumes only explicit repeat measurements of the original BASE cells; it resolves the temporal confound before any new training hypothesis.
next_gate: Run the bounded first BASE-R cell on one authorized live-idle UUID, then only the remaining preregistered BASE-R cells. Reconcile period bridge before considering H1.38.

planned_matrix.task_selection: exactly the first 48 task identities in the sealed H1.37 manifest, in original BASE launch order; no new task selection
planned_matrix.single_gpu_gate: task 668 x all 4 frozen seeds, part of the formal 192-episode matrix; no extra smoke episode

primary_estimands.period_bridge: BASE-R minus original BASE on exact task/seed pairs; report attempt- and task-weighted means, cluster CI, and sign-flip inference.
primary_estimands.same_period_transfer: SELF-resumed minus BASE-R on exact task/seed pairs; report attempt- and task-weighted means, cluster CI, and sign-flip inference.

robustness: all-attempt ITT-style score comparison assigns score 0 to invalid attempts but never calls them scientifically valid
per-arm parser/fallback, runtime, identity, and incomplete-trace failures are reported separately
all missing task/seed pairs are enumerated; complete-case counts never replace 48 x 4 coverage
61/64 H1.37 original paired-task limitation remains historical and is separately counted
forbidden_changes: no extra tasks, seeds, or retries

decision_branches.stable_null_like: If period bridge is stable and SELF-resumed versus BASE-R remains null-like, begin separate H1.38 endogenous task-diversity feasibility gate.
decision_branches.runtime_instability: If the bridge shows material instability or asymmetric validity failures, stop before new scientific arms and repair/re-freeze evaluation stability.
decision_branches.credible_positive_transfer: If SELF-resumed versus BASE-R has task-cluster CI lower bound above zero without a bridge failure, preregister untouched-task confirmation before tuning.

tracking.offline_fallback: only after a saved online probe failure and a completed spool hash

hard_boundaries: Host operator is root through experiment-host; scientific process runs UID/GID 1001:1001.
Use only listed UUIDs which pass a live idle gate immediately before launch.
Do not kill, reset, preempt, or restart any workload.
Completed cells are never re-run; a partial cell is a stop-and-reconcile condition.
